game_title: Break Out – Torchlit Cave Mouth Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the torchbearer ahead. Then check the alert value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lantern post by solving code steps involving alert that move the torchbearer forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lantern post first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Torchlit Cave Mouth'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
